sql: SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price) a FROM districts d JOIN properties p ON d.district_id=p.district_id JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE pt.property_type_name='Terraced' AND strftime('%Y-%m',t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY a DESC, d.district_name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT pt.property_type_name, AVG(t.price), RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(t.price) DESC) FROM property_types pt JOIN properties p ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m',t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT pt.property_type_name, 100.0*SUM(t.tenure_code='L')/COUNT(*) FROM property_types pt JOIN properties p ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE t.ppd_category_code='A' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price), AVG(t.price)-(SELECT AVG(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') FROM districts d JOIN properties p ON d.district_id=p.district_id JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY d.district_name

SELECT c.county_name, 100.0*SUM(t.new_build_code='Y')/COUNT(*) pct FROM counties c JOIN districts d ON c.county_id=d.county_id JOIN properties p ON d.district_id=p.district_id JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name ORDER BY pct DESC, c.county_name

WITH r AS (SELECT pt.property_type_name n, t.transaction_id, t.price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY t.price DESC, t.transaction_id ASC) rn FROM property_types pt JOIN properties p ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') SELECT n, transaction_id, price FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY n

WITH a AS (SELECT c.county_name cn, d.district_name dn, AVG(t.price) v FROM counties c JOIN districts d ON c.county_id=d.county_id JOIN properties p ON d.district_id=p.district_id JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name, d.district_name), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cn ORDER BY v DESC, dn ASC) rn FROM a) SELECT cn, dn, v FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY cn
